title: Inugami
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Fumiki, a young man who dreams of being a poet, meets a speaking dog marked '23' that can push blades from its forehead and was sent by a higher power to 'observe mankind' (ANN summary via AniList). A secret organization led by Kiryu hunts the dog to gain control of Tokoyonokuni, a paradise of eternal life across the ocean of the dead. MangaUpdates tags list blood and gore, murders, experiments, ESP and environmentalism across 14 volumes.
life_message: It appears to hold up friendship and trust across species, and a critical look at human greed for power and eternal life (to verify).
